dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Discontinuous concave trailing edge characterized by multiple irregular notches and a primary deep excision mid-way between the apex and the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with an approximate 20-pixel radius, classified as obtuse with a slight posterior lean.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal plane of the visible dorsal attachment.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.2:1 ratio of the visible base width to the vertical height from base to apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive structural damage to the trailing edge including one large V-shaped notch, several smaller U-shaped nicks, and a jagged lower-posterior margin. Faint, superficial linear desquamation or scratching visible on the central lateral surface of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific sequence and depth of the trailing edge notches provide a unique, high-contrast identifier profile.
